Privacy Policy

On-device no upload
The short version:

Your webcam frames and hand landmarks are processed entirely in your browser. They are never transmitted to any server. We do not collect, store, or share your biometric data.

What data we process

  • Webcam video: Processed locally in your browser by MediaPipe Hands (WebAssembly). Frames are never stored or transmitted.
  • Hand landmarks: 21 (x, y, z) coordinates per frame, computed on-device. Never transmitted.
  • Progress data: Stored in your browser localStorage under the key signtutor.progress. Never synced to a server in v1.
  • Preferences: Stored in localStorage under signtutor.prefs. Never synced.

What we do not collect

  • No webcam frames or video recordings
  • No hand landmark data
  • No biometric identifiers
  • No account information (no accounts in v1)
  • No analytics or telemetry (v1)

Content Security Policy

Lesson pages enforce a Content Security Policy that restricts outbound network connections to the same origin only (model files served from /models/). This is a technical guarantee that no webcam data can be exfiltrated.

Clearing your data

To delete all locally stored progress and preferences, clear your browser localStorage for this site. In Chrome: DevTools - Application - Local Storage - right-click - Clear.
